title: Design Movie Rental System
summary: Design a movie rental system across n shops: search returns up to five cheapest shops with an unrented copy of a movie (by price, then shop id); rent and drop change a copy's rented state; report returns up to five cheapest rented copies as [shop, movie] (by price, then shop, then movie).
officialConstraints: n up to 3*10^5; entries up to 10^5; movie and price up to 10^4; at most 10^5 calls in total (from the recovered statement).
visualizationNotes: Not built: full statement, constraints and examples were not verifiably obtained.
inputFormat: Constructor takes n and a list of [shop, movie, price] entries; search takes a movie id; rent and drop take shop and movie; report takes nothing.
outputFormat: search returns a list of shop ids; report returns a list of [shop, movie] pairs; rent and drop return nothing.
tieRules: Price ascending, then shop ascending; report then movie ascending.
edgeRules: Rent is called only for unrented copies and drop only for previously rented copies.
nextAction: Official page confirmation pending. Recovered statement is complete for the requirements; examples are not copied to the website.
